title: Preparing a Personal Portfolio SPA for Public Launch
excerpt: A draft look at the release-readiness work behind the Trevis Portfolio project, including route smoke tests, documentation cleanup, governance review, and public-content validation before launch.

sections.heading: Project Snapshot
sections.body: Trevis Portfolio is a personal portfolio application built with Vite and owned by TrevisCleary. The application is running locally as the primary service and is in an in-progress Release Readiness phase. Screenshots have been captured for the Home, About, and Projects routes from the local app and require review before publishing.

sections.heading: Release Readiness Focus
sections.body: The release effort centers on making the portfolio safe, reviewable, and ready for public validation. Completed remediation items include route and asset smoke tests, README updates covering current routes and project structure, cleanup around the dedicated case-study routing model, and documentation for a repeatable intake-to-case-study promotion workflow.

sections.heading: Screenshots captured for review
sections.body: RidgePath Forge captured 4 local screenshot drafts for portfolio review. These images remain draft assets until reviewed and promoted into public project media.

sections.heading: Governance and Security Review
sections.body: The project governance status is pass-with-gaps. A high-priority governance item remains in validation for a tracked Power Automate Desktop source export documented as containing sensitive credential material. This item should be removed, scrubbed, or formally governed before public launch. Public content and media review also remains a manual-review requirement for resume, contact information, screenshots, and case-study claims.

sections.heading: Deployment Validation
sections.body: Production deployment and direct SPA route refresh behavior on Vercel remain in validation. The next release action is to commit the current remediation set, resolve owner-only security and content review items, and disable or intentionally bypass Vercel Deployment Protection before public launch validation.

sections.heading: Draft Review Notes
sections.body: This copy should not be treated as published content. Before publishing, confirm the final public route list, review captured screenshots, verify deployment behavior, and complete the owner-only review of all public-facing resume, contact, media, and case-study materials.
